Respondent instructions: State the offered transaction and confirm who can sign. Give the address, parcel IDs, offered boundary and option or offer expiration.
Identify the title, survey and agreements for the offered land. List separate access, drainage and utility rights the first phase needs.
State facility MW at the meter, earliest documented service date, serving utility, delivery point and evidence stage. Attach the source document and give its conditions.
Identify required utility and customer upgrades, route rights, cost responsibilities, deposits, minimum bills and service limitations.
Supply a dated concept plan. Mark building and equipment pads, access, corridors and exclusions. Report usable acres and how they were calculated.
State design demand and supply points. Identify the serving providers, fire flow and the evidence behind the available capacity.
Identify the discharge point and receiver. Supply written capacity or service terms and explain any pretreatment or discharge requirements.
Identify each carrier and installation date. Mark building entrances, shared routes and the latency measurement endpoints.
State the jurisdiction, use and permit pathway, docket or permit ID, next decision date and conditions required before grading, service or operation.
Give dates for land commitment, early works, service, commissioning and opening. List who will verify each remaining item and when.
